subject: Taxes
title: China's Yellow Turban Revolt
description: A quick win: understand China's Yellow Turban Revolt.

hook.text: In 184 CE, over 360,000 Chinese peasants wearing yellow turbans revolted.

buildup.text: The Han dynasty taxed grain at up to 50% while local officials demanded bribes. Peasants had nothing left to eat.

discovery.text: Zhang Jue, a Taoist healer, organized the uprising. He promised a new 'Yellow Heaven' free from unjust taxes.

twist.text: The revolt was crushed, but it fatally weakened the Han dynasty.

climax.text: The Yellow Turbans didn't win, but they ended an empire. Taxes that starve people eventually destroy the state.

punchline.text: Starving peasants in yellow. A tax revolt ended the Han dynasty.

quiz.question: What dynasty was fatally weakened by the Yellow Turban Revolt?
